messages:
Rhea M.: Following up from today's all-hands reliability Q&A  capturing the quick action list and owners. RCA link: https://docs.redwood.com/rcas/INC-3841. Keep replies short so I can roll up the exec note. :memo:

Theo L.: From product: need a firm canary date for the failover-routing change we discussed. Teams want a calendar invite.

Omar S.: Support chiming in: also need explicit telemetry keys we will monitor so dashboards can be copied.

Rhea M.: Proposed canary start 2026-04-22 09:00 UTC in prod-canary, monitoring window 48h. Ramp plan: 0.5% -> 5% -> 20% if green. I'll create the invite when owners confirm.

Theo L.: Works for product. Please add success/rollback gates to the PR.

Omar S.: Quick suggested rollback/success gates:
- sustained 5xx > 0.4% for 10m -> rollback
- p95 latency +20% over baseline for 10m -> rollback
- >=3 distinct customer-impact reports mentioning the canary tag -> pause and triage
I'll add these to the runbook checklist.

Rhea M.: Thanks. Owner assignments so I can build the register: canary orchestration -> @Theo L., long-tail tracing retention -> @Omar S., customer comms pack -> @Amy L.

Amy L.: Finance note: tracing retention bump estimate is ~$4.2k/mo. If under $5k I can route approval via finance liaison; will mark approved once it's on the register.

Theo L.: Implementer deploy snippet for ops folks:
```
# apply failover-routing canary in prod-canary
kubectl -n infra apply -f configs/failover-routing-2026-04-22.yaml --context=prod-canary
# ramp pauses: 10m between steps, burst window 25s
```

Ops-bot: Canary job queued: failover-routing-2026-04-22 in prod-canary at 2026-04-22T09:00:00Z (build 1298).

Omar S.: I'll paste telemetry tag examples into the runbook (svc:router, route:chat, incident:INC-3841) and add example PromQL queries for p95 and 5xx.

Rhea M.: Who will maintain the action register and publish the weekly exec snapshot? Need a single contact.

Theo L.: I'll keep the register and publish a Friday EOD status. Register fields: action, owner, due, status, blocker, notes.

Amy L.: Please include a short customer-facing template for potential pause messages. Product wants it ready. I'll review copy.

Omar S.: Will add the template to the runbook. Also adding an explicit escalation map (on-call -> infra lead -> product ops -> exec on-call) with Slack channels and phone numbers.

Rhea M.: One more ask from support: schedule a 24h checkpoint meeting after canary start to review telemetry and decide next steps. Who can own that?

Amy L.: I can host the 24h checkpoint. Add it to the calendar invite.

Theo L.: I'll open the canary PR and tag product/support for review. Expect PR in ~2h.

Rhea M.: Runbook draft link: https://docs.redwood.com/runbooks/failover-canary-2026-04. I'll consolidate this thread into the master action register and push the exec summary Friday. DM me if blocked. :white_check_mark:
